name: 3-methyl-PCPy
summary: 3-Methyl-PCPy (3-Me-PCPy) is an arylcyclohexylamine derivative with an unusual spectrum of pharmacological effects, acting as both a potent NMDA antagonist and also a triple reuptake inhibitor which inhibits reuptake of all three monoamine neurotransmitters serotonin, dopamine and noradrenaline. It also acts as a high affinity sigma receptor ligand, selective for the σ2 subtype.

pharmacology.text: In in vitro binding assays, 3-Me-PCPy displays high affinities across monoamine reuptake transporters alongside the NMDA receptor complex. Unusually for an arylcyclohexylamine dissociative, its affinity for the serotonin transporter (SERT) is approximately ten-fold higher than its affinity for the NMDA receptor pore.
